group_action.action: generated by symplectic transvections over F3

interpretation: The oriented bridge survives full automorphism twirling exactly as the isotropic density (8/81)P_H1. The chosen gauge basis is erased, but the H1 trace survives. This is distinct from all-positive support twirling, which BT1675 showed has zero H1 content.
boundary: The result is numerical over the generated projective symplectic action. It strongly supports the Schur/isotypic formula; a formal proof would identify the H1 representation component explicitly.
